entries.speaker: How to Play Darts
entries.en: Use your wireless controller to aim and hold [f 1 10 57][n]to confirm where you would like to throw the dart.[n]You can also press [f 1 10 30] to reset the targeted area.
entries.uk: Цільтеся бездротовим контролером і утримуйте [f 1 10 57], щоб[n]підтвердити, куди кинути дротик. Натиснувши [f 1 10 30], можна[n]скинути вибрану зону.

entries.speaker: How to Play Darts
entries.en: Shake the controller to throw the dart at the[n][clr 2]targeted area[clr 27]. Take care not to let go of the[n]controller.
entries.uk: Струсніть контролер, щоб кинути дротик у [clr 2]вибрану зону[clr 27].[n]Тільки не випустіть контролер із рук.

entries.en: Use your wireless controller to aim.

entries.speaker: How to Play Darts
entries.en: Use [f 1 10 71] to move and [f 1 10 72] to rotate[n]and adjust your aim.

entries.en: Use [f 1 10 71] or the mouse to move and [f 1 10 72] to rotate[n]and adjust your aim.
entries.uk: [f 1 10 71] чи миша — переміщення, [f 1 10 72] — обертання й корекція[n]прицілу.

entries.speaker: How to Play Darts
entries.en: Hold [f 1 10 57] to confirm where you would like[n]to throw the dart. You can also press [f 1 10 30][n]to reset the targeted area.

entries.en: Hold down [f 1 10 57] to decide where to throw.[n]If your aim shifts, you can reset by pressing [f 1 10 30].
